short: The crate body — feature-free substrate, each I/O or crypto surface behind a feature
is: The crate body — a feature-free substrate (`plc`, `did`, `handle`, `keys`, `vault`, `policy`, `store`, `error`) with each I/O or crypto surface behind its own feature.
conventions: Private modules are re-exported from `lib.rs`; only `plc`, `acp`, `axum`, `oauth`, `postgres`, `vc` are `pub mod`.
Unit tests live beside the code and use `memory.rs` fakes.

fs.name: acp.rs
fs.role: `acp` feature root — ACP core module docs + re-exports

fs.name: acp/
fs.role: the ACP core — records, sign/verify, ports, status lists, policy

fs.name: broker.rs
fs.role: the toolkit layer — future credential behavior home

fs.name: directory.rs
fs.role: `directory` feature — HTTP submit to a PLC directory

fs.name: lib.rs
fs.role: crate root — module map, feature gates, public re-exports

fs.role: `minter` feature — Minter: mint / update handle / tombstone
